issues.on_page: Non-Reimbursable Programs 7,341 (School Nutrition Fund, Local Sources)
issues.issue: Non-reimbursable programs are meal/a la carte sales not reimbursed by the federal program, not a reimbursement or refund. The category contradicts the label, the line's own detail_category (other charges for services) and the statement split (receipts[21], where the same 7,341 is charges for services). Under the 2026-10-28 rule it fits School Lunch Sales
